description: Declarative inventory for machine guardrails. The current check-guardrail-registration.mjs enforces auto-enumerated script coverage, required declarations, and textual Make-target/CI-step reachability only. It does not yet prove semantic recipe execution, ordinary affected-job routing, existence/uniqueness of every referenced resource, or spoof resistance; F0 in the current remediation ledger must add those checks. Each entry declares the target, real check, adversarial self-test (or explicit exemption), owning documentation, and intended ordinary-CI status.

conventions.requiredInCI: true => the guard is intended to run from a standard run_common/component job in tools/ci/run-local-ci.sh, and when makeTarget is set that target is intended to appear in Makefile:guardrails. The current meta-guard checks textual reachability; F0 must prove actual invocation and reject compatibility-only, commented, echoed, dead-branch, or wrong-target wiring.
conventions.selfTest: Every guard MUST declare a selfTest command OR a selfTestExemptReason. A guard with neither fails registration.
conventions.autoEnumerationScope: check-guardrail-registration.mjs enumerates every check-*.mjs AND check-*.sh (excluding *.test.sh) under tools/agent-hooks/ and tools/ci/ and fails if any is absent from `guards[].script`. Guards outside those two directories, and non-mjs/non-sh guards, are registered by hand and are NOT auto-enumerated.

guards.notes: Publishing a plan version must only touch the rules that actually changed: adding a 6th vaccine to a plan of 5 leaves those 5 operationally untouched -- same obligation_id, same due_at, same task/batch/proof attachment -- with only protocol_version_id moving. Checks the three ways that guarantee breaks without looking like a bug: the carry-over call vanishing from the supersede path, due_at or status joining the carry-over UPDATE, and a scheduling field dropping out of the rule content fingerprint (which would make an edit read as unchanged and never reach an animal). Lens CD-ADDITIVE-PUBLISH in the review-lens ledger.

No dedicated Make target: `guardrails:` invokes the script (and its --self-test) directly, and run_common runs both. The self-test builds synthetic admin-web/Go fixtures in a tmpdir and asserts the guard REJECTS them (direct BigQuery/Sheets access, cross-feature deep imports, silent recover()).

guards.selfTestExemptReason: No self-test: this is an agent PreToolUse hook, not a CI lint. It exits 0 unless the operator has placed a .agent/scope.json in the worktree, and it is driven end-to-end by every agent file write through .claude/settings.json and .codex/hooks.json - that live wiring, not a fixture, is what exercises it. It has no CI step to attach a fixture to.
guards.notes: Not in the Makefile, not in `guardrails:`, and not in tools/ci/run-local-ci.sh. Exposed as `npm run check:scope` and wired as an agent PreToolUse hook only.

Every Android OutboxOpType explicitly declares immediate UI, success reconciliation, terminal-failure, and process-death policy; wildcard coverage is rejected.
Authoring guard for the documented proof-video pipeline; it is not part of the default landing matrix.
Authoring guard for screenshot extraction from Android proof videos; it is not part of the default landing matrix.
Blocks row-level Android card actions from using a screen-wide busy gate. Covers the individual weighing free-flow regression where animal A's pending save disabled/ignored animal B's Save.

Runtime permission request/blocking lists must gate OS-versioned permissions by SDK. POST_NOTIFICATIONS is runtime-grantable only on Android 13+, so Android 12 capture/upload entry must never require it.

Blocks the Android proof_rescan regression where a proof-missing DONE goat can upload proof without repairing the durable scan capture. Submit summary counts sop_task_scan_captures, so accepted proof_rescan must call recordRosterScan before requestGoatProof.

Vaccination and weighing proof captures must pass feature/task overlay context through the shared proof pipeline, burn RFID only for per-animal captures, and keep the phone-QA 2/3-animal plus two-vaccine fixture.

Blocks the 2026-08-11 Android verifier regression where a Weighing queue row showed video but detail opened without the same status/date/missed scope, observed the wrong Room cache slice, and rendered 'No video attached to this item'.
ROUTE-CLOSURE enforcement: planner tool names resolve in Cube/API/Toolbox/SQL catalog, RouteAPI targets are wired or have fallbacks, and coverage-matrix rows reference valid golden eval questions.

Blocks the three operator-cascade wiring anti-patterns proven broken at origin/main f9a44b84: (B) an eventbus handler type with Register(bus eventbus.Bus) that is missing from a DURABLE bus (backend/internal/kernelstages/bus.go and backend/cmd/domain-event-consumer/main.go) while being registered only on bootstrap/api.go or domainconsumer/wiring/bus.go, which nothing real dispatches to; (A) a sweeper function consuming DB-reported operator.Cap without subtracting session.vaccinationOperatorLoad, which lets a later rule-version in the same sweep over-select past the per-operator/day cap; (C) a write to workforce_positions cap/week-off, vaccination_capacity_config, or vaccination_operator_assignment_config that never enqueues vaccination.capacity.changed / vaccination.roster.changed. Deliberate durable-bus omissions must be declared in DURABLE_BUS_EXEMPTIONS with a written reason, and the guard re-verifies that the exemption's declared registration site still registers the handler.

guards.selfTestExemptReason: No self-test: this guard owns no predicate of its own to attack. It is a 30-line executor that asserts the contract directories exist and then delegates the entire check to `npm --prefix tools/contract-validation run validate` and `make api-client-check`, which carry their own fixtures and failure modes. An adversarial fixture here would only prove that `npm run validate` was spawned.
guards.notes: No dedicated Make target: `guardrails:` invokes the script directly; run_common runs it as `agent: contract-drift`.
Keeps ICU/quarantine/death/high-risk movement interim fail-closed rules visible until full policy-pack modules ship.
Enforces the AGENTS.md rule that an E2E may seed source/input facts but never the derived kernel result it claims to prove. run_backend runs it as `agent: e2e-kernel-integrity`.
Blocks role-visible-but-no-push regressions: tenant leadership push recipients must resolve from active grants/device tokens, and STG verifier seed must create pc.vaccination verify duty routing.

Feed distribution proof slots are a shared PARALLEL workspace (maintainer contract 2026-08-15): one shed-session, three slots (weight photo, feed video, water video), filled by peer operators from different phones in any split; no slot gates another; media always uploads compressed + overlay-burned. Five failure modes: (1) a FeedDistributionUiState slot-enabled getter referencing another slot's captured/status flag (sequential gating); (2) CaptureRepository Gate-3 backstop validating photos with the video probe (mime-blind - forced raw-original fallback three times in the field on 2026-08-15); (3) processed-artifact validation called without the output mime type; (4) AppProofMediaProcessor dropping the audit overlay or JPEG compression from the photo path, or the overlay composition from the video path; (5) deletion of the pinned regression tests (ProcessedPhotoValidatorRegressionTest, FeedDistributionSequenceTest, the gate-3 real-JPEG CaptureRepositoryTest case).

Keeps the queued-submit badge overlay wired end to end (bug 254.mp4: submit a shed-session, return to the worklist, row still reads Pending because the write is only in the outbox). Every Feed worklist renders its chip from lifecycleStatus, so three parts must all survive: the submit ViewModel calls markSubmittedForReview on ENQUEUE SUCCESS; the list ViewModel combines feedCompletionStore.submittedForReviewKeys; and its row mapping runs the status through overlayFeedLifecycleStatus. Deleting any one silently restores the bug while every unit test still passes, because the rule's own tests call the pure function directly and cannot see a severed call site. Also pins overlayFeedLifecycleStatus to exactly ONE definition: Feed Packing and Feed Direction previously drifted apart with per-flow copies. A paging-level test was tried first and rejected — `rows` ends in cachedIn(viewModelScope) and asSnapshot() never settles under runTest (UncompletedCoroutinesError), so a structural guard is deterministic where that test was flaky.
Firebase proof analytics must stay a compact allowlisted envelope; rich address/location/path/error details stay in backend analytics and Room events.
Post-seed/import DB proof. It requires DATABASE_URL and is run by tools/dev/seed-closeout.sh, not by ordinary no-DB CI.

Herd Signals product claim boundary: the HoneyComm BLE ear tag exposes only tag id/MAC, RSSI, battery, tag temperature, cumulative motion_count, sensor-OK bits, gateway id, and timestamps -- it cannot detect eating, rumination, sitting, standing, lying, walking, running, fever, body temperature, or disease. Scans backend/internal/herdsignals/**, apps/admin-web/features/herd-signals/**, the herd-signals slice of contracts/openapi/app-api.yaml, docs/modules/herd-signals.md (allowlisted as the boundary's source of truth), and mock/herd-signals-mock.html for claim-shaped assertions of a banned term, body-temperature mislabeling, and mock/demo/sample/synthetic UI copy leaks. See docs/modules/herd-signals.md Section 3.
KERN-01: asserts exactly one active owner per stage while dev remains on the transitional flag. Staging's completed cutover is covered by stg-disposable-topology.
Two-phase legacy-job retirement gate. Run explicitly during a cutover; not in the standing run-local-ci.sh guardrails job.

Maintains separation between Leadership (audit/overview, read-only) and Verifier (action queue, verdict casting) surfaces. Enforces: (1) leadership nav hrefs do not point to /verify* routes, (2) leadership Android screens do not import from feature-verify, (3) verdict controls (approve/reject) do not appear in leadership screens. Incident 2026-08-06: leadership Videos nav was repointed at a verifier route, causing leadership screens to reflect every verifier UI change and creating UX confusion about readable vs. actionable content.

requiredInCI=false records that no ordinary tools/ci/run-local-ci.sh component job invokes this target. `make guardrails` does invoke it, and its Make target runs the .test.sh self-test before the real check. F0 must decide and enforce ordinary affected-job routing or a precise reviewed exemption.

guards.selfTestExemptReason: No self-test: the guard has no injectable input - it asserts required literal lines in a hardcoded list of committed runtime/rule files resolved from its own repo root, so the only fixture it can be fed is the repo itself (delete the single-DB resolution line from tools/dev/run-local-stack.sh and it fails). Recorded blind spot: it proves the text is present, not that a launcher resolves exactly one Goat OS database at runtime; the runtime behaviour is proven by local-stack-service-guard.
guards.notes: Already wired before this registration: run_backend of tools/ci/run-local-ci.sh runs `local-single-db-guard`, and the Makefile `guardrails:` target already invoked it. Only the manifest entry was missing.

Detects duplicate migration version numbers under backend/migrations/postgres/. Two files with the same numeric prefix (e.g., 000031_a.sql and 000031_b.sql) create a silent goose ordering hazard and must be caught before push.
Required in Android local CI: backend bootstrap/nav/feature_flags own mobile visibility and execution affordances.

guards.selfTestExemptReason: Fixture/DOM click integrity checker driven end-to-end by `apps/admin-web` check:mock-fidelity and tools/agent-hooks/check-mock.sh; it has no isolated unit surface to adversarially self-test.

guards.notes: v4: rewritten to compare RENDERED, BROWSER-COMPUTED styles (Playwright/Chromium getComputedStyle) between the approved mock and the live app at :3318, instead of statically parsing and hand-resolving CSS text. The old static resolver could not see DOM ancestry, so equal-specificity rules from OTHER admin screens sharing a bare class (e.g. Action Center's .task-ac .tag vs this page's .herd-signals-page .tag) looked like competing rules and produced ~76 false findings nobody could triage without opening devtools -- one of which was 'fixed' by adding a bare-classname duplicate rule to the shared global stylesheet, which had to be reverted. A real browser resolves ancestry/specificity/cascade correctly, so this version asks Chromium directly: it loads both pages, walks a curated, deliberately-paired element registry (by class + position/role, never by content -- the mock has invented fixture data and the app has ~20 real tags) across Live Monitor, Animals, Gateways, Alerts, Tag Mapping, Insights, the row-click drawer and the full-screen history, and diffs colour/background/border/border-radius/font/padding/margin/gap/display/grid-template-columns. Needs both dev servers running -- fails loudly with a clear message if either is down, never silently passes. Cannot see hover/focus states, media queries, or anything behind an interaction it does not drive (see the script header's full limits list). A separate, unchanged banned-pattern scan blocks reintroducing the mock's invented battery-life-estimate text, which the style comparison alone would miss since its class is already styled for other fields.

guards.selfTestExemptReason: No self-test: it has no injectable input and no predicate of its own beyond `new Function(src)`. It parses every inline <script> of the one committed file mock/goatos-dashboard-mock.html (the fixture IS the repo file: introduce a syntax error there and Tier 1 fails), then delegates Tier 2 to tools/agent-hooks/check-mock-clicks.mjs, which is registered separately with its own entry.

`make guardrails` invokes this target, but no ordinary `tools/ci/run-local-ci.sh` component job invokes it today. requiredInCI=false records that current gap; F0 must either wire the affected mobile job or retain a reviewed exemption with a precise reason.

Pre-existing violations pinned in tools/agent-hooks/nav-entry-point-baseline.txt (currently the weighing 'My work' top-right bell).

Maintainer decision 2026-08-02: blocks abstract count-only notification copy (e.g. "Vaccination(s) due soon - 3") in backend/internal/notificationbridge/**. Requires park/shed/vaccine-name/date specificity in Title/Body. Composes with ui-vaccine-labels (raw-token humanization) rather than duplicating it.
Keeps the pluggable vertical/read-model contract discoverable for Claude, Codex, build skills, review lenses, frontend/mobile lenses, and local CI.

Detects callers of operatorCapacityPlanner / effectiveOperatorAnimalCap in backend/internal/obligation/app/** that feed the returned cap into a capacity limit/lock sink without a fail-closed check (driveOperatorCapacityExhausted, or maxDriveCells>0 && effectiveCap<=0), which reintroduces the F1 fail-open (cap<=0 read as uncapped) on a config-present-but-no-executable-operator day.

Proof/evidence capture is authorized by the SAME execution right that authorizes the work it proves. Structurally joins the role->permission maps (permissions.go rolePermissions + permissions_orgrole.go tierPermissions) to the route table (routes.go protectedRoutes) and re-implements AuthorizeRoute's AND/OR semantics: every role holding any *Execute permission MUST be authorized for every /app/proofs write route. Catches the 2026-08-03 shipped defect where the proof routes were gated on the vaccination-era TaskExecute alone, so a growth_director (WeighingExecute, deliberately NOT TaskExecute) could record a weighing observation but 403'd on POST /app/proofs/uploads -- no proof ever reached SYNCED and lump-sum Submit stayed permanently disabled. Self-test includes an adversarial reconstruction of that exact defect plus a future-vertical case (a new *Execute permission with no proof access), so a new vertical cannot repeat it. Blind spots are enumerated in the script header: runtime-composed grants, handler-level authorization inside a proof endpoint, scope/tenant narrowing, evidence surfaces outside /app/proofs, and AdminOnly routes.

Admin-web pages are role-agnostic single components, so role differences must come from the backend page contract (capability-gated controls/option_groups), never a role-string conditional in the component. Enforces on a fixed, extendable file list (features/verification-review/verification-review-page.tsx today): (1) no role/permission string literal drives a rendering branch, (2) known oversight-only chrome (module chips, the capture-date range picker) is never present without a controlEnabled(pageContract, ...) gate somewhere in the file. Incident (STG, 2026-08-12): the CEO's oversight filters on /verify rendered for every role that could open the page, including RoleVerifier.

Authoring wrapper only. The underlying telemetry guard runs elsewhere, but this wrapper has no Make target, ordinary CI step, or live PostToolUse wiring. F0 owns a truthful registration/wiring decision.
Final staging topology: no Scheduler resources or transitional flag, one enabled kernel-worker service, analytics retained as a manual job, and Cloud Deploy updates/verifies the worker image.

Blocks STG login seed regressions where real operator/director field accounts get tenant-scope grants. Operators/directors must declare ParkCode and the seeder must materialize park-scoped grants while revoking stale tenant grants.

Detects Go test files with stray build constraints (// +build pgtest, //go:build pgtest, etc.) that cause them to be silently excluded from CI runs. Postgres tests must gate at runtime via GOATOS_RUN_POSTGRES_TESTS=1 + pgtest.SkipIfNoDocker(), not via build tags.
Raw vaccination config/protocol tokens are allowed in config/contracts/DTOs/tests only. User-facing admin-web/mobile UI must render human labels.

Blocks coupled vaccination regressions: blank-history adults disappearing unless a manual campaign is fired, repeat windows being contaminated by primary-course rows, sub-cap physical sheds being partition-split in park pre-batching or operator planning, CPT route order drifting from the 193/131 whole-shed calendar, completion totals multiplying by assignment rows, and delayed verification/director closeout replacing the operator-submitted administered_at medical anchor.
Post-sweeper DB proof. It requires DATABASE_URL and is run by seed closeout/reseed evidence after the sweeper.

Calendar, Protocol Adherence, Action Center, and Workflows must share vaccination_drive_assignments as the canonical operator-day source; admin-web page switches must not fan out into N+1 vaccination/calendar/process-integrity fetches.

THE CLOSE GATE IS UNCONDITIONAL (maintainer decision 2026-08-03). Weighing has exactly two verbs, close and reopen; there is no force/override/skip variant of close and 'abandon' is a deleted verb. AGENTS.md claimed this script enforced the rule from 2026-08-03, but the FILE DID NOT EXIST until 2026-08-07 -- the gate was real in close.go and tested, yet nothing stopped a refactor from removing it while every author who read that line believed a machine was watching. Three failure modes: (1) close-gate-removed, no ErrVerificationPending reference survives anywhere in weighing; (2) close-bypass-parameter, a force/override/skip/ignore-verification flag on a weighing close request in Go/Kotlin/TS; (3) abandon-verb-returns, the deleted 'abandon' verb reappearing outside tests. BLIND SPOTS, stated so this guard is not over-trusted the way the missing one was: it cannot prove the gate is reached at runtime on every path (close.go's own tests do that), and it matches on NAMES, so a bypass named inventively (expedite, fastPath) passes -- extend the vocabulary when you meet one.

Weighing is free-flow (maintainer decision 2026-07-31, STRICT form). The observation write path may touch ONLY weighing-owned tables plus proof/idempotency/audit/outbox: no goats, no weighing_expected_animals, no vaccination tables, no clinical state; the write REQUEST must never require or carry animal_id; and no weighing UI may render an expected-animal denominator. Ten failure modes: (1) vaccination/herd-roster read in the write path; (2) animal_id NOT NULL reintroduced; (3) UNIQUE on scanned_identifier collapsing it across campaign_shed_id buckets; (4) rejecting a null animal_id instead of routing to the scanned_identifier path; (5) clinical-state read (goats.health_status / lifecycle_status / a clinical-defer vocabulary) used to gate a write; (6) weighing_expected_animals.status / availability_status used as a gate rather than a label; (7) STRICT allowlist catch-all for any table outside the weighing-owned set; (8) a Go struct tag or validator-library call making AnimalID a required/non-empty precondition anywhere in the module; (9) an Android Kotlin `Weighing*RequestDto` (the write-request DTO shape) declaring an animal_id/animalId field — scoped narrowly to that naming convention, so it does not fire on the read/response DTO, a Room entity, or Vaccination DTOs; (10) a weighing UI surface (Android Compose weighing screens, admin-web weighing pages) rendering/computing a ratio against an expected/roster-named denominator, or a literal N/N or /100 progress token. Scans the transitive closure of same-file helpers called from the write entry points, so extracting a gate into a private helper does not hide it. Vaccination stays strict and is untouched by this guard.

guards.selfTestExemptReason: Editor-hook wrapper (PostToolUse in .claude/settings.json), not a CI gate: it re-runs the already-registered weighing isolation guard at edit time so the failure surfaces at the decision point instead of hours later in the matrix. The underlying guard carries the real check and its own coverage; a self-test here would only assert that a hook shells out.

guards.notes: PRE-CUTOVER compatibility continuity guard, not permanent coordination authority. It currently protects the deployed Weighing source work ledger/stage while shared task materialization is absent. F0/task-kernel cutover must replace its private-coordination requirements with receipt/version-fenced outward materialization, parity/reconciliation, no duplicate tasks or contacts, shared contact authority, and no inbound Weighing dependency before retiring or demoting the legacy lane. Until cutover, the publish transaction must materialize durable weighing_work_items; claims remain bounded/keyseted; business time remains Asia/Kolkata day grain; and recipients are never hardcoded.

weighing_campaign_sheds.operator_user_id must stay NOT NULL with exactly one operator per bucket: no dropped NOT NULL, no second/backup operator column, no operator array column or many-operators join table.

Operator-facing weighing list/roster queries must filter by operator_user_id in SQL before LIMIT (never paginate then filter), and execute-scoped HTTP routes must derive operator scope from the authenticated actor, never a client-supplied field.
